name: Marvel Cinematic Universe
llm_hint: Include Marvel Studios films and Disney+ series (Phases 1-6+). Exclude Fox X-Men/Fantastic Four films, Sony's non-MCU Spider-Man films (Venom, Morbius), and making-of/documentary specials.

name: Star Wars
llm_hint: Include the theatrical Skywalker Saga, spin-off films (Rogue One, Solo), and live-action/animated Disney+ series (Mandalorian, Andor, Ahsoka, Clone Wars, Rebels, etc). Exclude fan films and non-canon Legends-era content.
